text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I went to eat at a Chinese restaurant. A few students from the academy were there as well—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Food, fooood~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I can't wait either, Urara-san.

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: Packed with heaps of precious spices! Our specialty, 'Blazing Red Fire-Breathing Mapo Tofu', two servings!!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: No one has ever managed to finish it all... Will you be able to clear your plates~? Well then, dig in!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? Huh-huh-huh~...?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?! The tofu is bright red!! My eyes are stinging just looking at it~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-No way... did I order the wrong thing?! Did I mess up again~?!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: No, no, we should have double-checked with you... We'll prepare a replacement dish right away!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...B-But... if you do that, this... will just get thrown out, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Um. If it's all right, may I eat it?

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: What?! But this is overwhelmingly spicy! Not a single person has ever finished a full portion—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... The stir-fried chili peppers have such a refreshing bite...
It's delicious...

text_block_list.name: Nearby Customer
text_block_list.text: —Wait, what? Is she eating... could that be THE ultra-spicy challenge dish?!

text_block_list.name: Customer Doubting Their Eyes
text_block_list.text: I-It looks like it, but... whoa!! She's already starting on the second plate?! That's insane!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you for the meal~~.

text_block_list.name: Nearby Customer
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me! Um, excuse me! How in the world can you eat something that spicy~?!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: To think I'd witness someone clearing a double portion with my own eyes... I-I-I'm deeply moved!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Hwaaah?
...Eeeek~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You're amazing, Doto-chan! That calls for a celebration~!

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Customers
text_block_list.text: (Woooooow~!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeek~?! E-E-Everyone~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not the kind of horse girl who deserves this much attention...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: G-G-Goodbyeee~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto slammed down her money at the register at blinding speed and bolted out of the restaurant. Unable to leave her alone, I rushed out after her, only to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *CLANG!*

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wahh?! Are you okay, Doto-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hw-Hwaaaahhhhh....

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ahhh, even you, Trainer-san?!
Seeing me at my most embarrassing~~~!
choice_data_list: Not at all, you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ahhh, even you, Trainer-san?!
Seeing me at my most embarrassing~~~!
choice_data_list: Not at all, you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...R-Really~~~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-S-S-Special, you say...!
I-It's still so embarrassing though~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even when praised, Meisho Doto only ended up becoming all the more flustered.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That was just... because the food was so delicious,
I accidentally ate it all, that's all...
choice_data_list: It made me want to try spicy food too!
It made me want to challenge something spicy too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that true?
That... might actually make me happy, um...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
—There you are, super-spicy missy!
Sorry about earlier, didn't mean to startle you!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
To make up for it, your next meal's on the house!
Feel free to drop by whenever you like!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay, on the house~! That's so awesome, Doto-chan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...
Uuu... <chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Right?! It was so cool~! Maybe I should try eating some mapo tofu too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That mapo tofu would undoubtedly be far too spicy for Haru Urara.
I hastily stopped her curious enthusiasm.
